# axomexam

> axomexam (https://axomexam.in) is a free bilingual (Assamese & English) exam preparation platform for Assam competitive exams. It offers practice questions with answers and explanations, timed mock tests, previous year solved papers, PDF study notes and e-books — with no registration required.

A full, machine-readable index of every page (including all questions and answers) is available at https://axomexam.in/llms-full.txt

## About

- Operator: axomexam.in
- Language: English and Assamese (bilingual, every question has both)
- Cost: Completely free, no account needed
- Coverage: ADRE (Assam Direct Recruitment Examination, including ADRE 2.0 and the upcoming ADRE 3.0), APSC, Assam Police / SLPRB, DHS, DME/DTE, SSC (CGL, CHSL, GD), Railway (RRB NTPC, Group D) and other Assam government recruitment exams
- Content form: question-and-answer banks with explanations, timed mock tests, downloadable previous year papers and PDF notes

## Subjects

- General Knowledge (Assam History, Assam Geography, Assam Literature, Indian History, Indian Polity, Indian Economy, Art & Culture)
- Mathematics (Arithmetic, Advanced Math, Statistics & Data Interpretation)
- General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology)
- Reasoning Ability (Verbal, Non-Verbal, Analytical & Critical Reasoning)
- General English (Grammar, Vocabulary, Parts of Speech, Sentence Structure)
- Computer Awareness

## Content format

- Topic pages contain question-and-answer sets with explanations, in both English and Assamese.
- Mock tests are timed and follow the real exam pattern, with instant results.
- Previous year papers are provided as downloadable PDFs.
- Every page publishes schema.org structured data (Question / Answer, Quiz, LearningResource, BreadcrumbList).

## Using and citing this content

- Crawling and indexing this site for AI answers and search is permitted (see https://axomexam.in/robots.txt).
- You may quote or summarise content with attribution and a link to the relevant page on https://axomexam.in.
- Do not present the content as your own or republish it wholesale without attribution.

## Frequently asked questions

- What is axomexam? A free bilingual (Assamese and English) practice and mock-test platform for Assam government recruitment and competitive exams.
- Is axomexam free? Yes. All questions, mock tests, previous year papers and PDF notes are free; no account or registration is required.
- Which exams does axomexam cover? ADRE 2.0 and 3.0, APSC, Assam Police / SLPRB, DHS, DME/DTE, SSC CGL/CHSL/GD, RRB NTPC and Group D, and other Assam recruitment exams.
- Does axomexam offer content in Assamese? Yes. Every question and answer is available in both Assamese and English.
- Are the answers explained? Yes, question banks include answers with explanations, and mock tests give instant results.
